stories.title: Pickett not budging on No. 5 amid Daniels-LSU flap
stories.summary: LSU's DJ Pickett says he has no plans to change out of the No. 5 amid pushback from Jayden Daniels, with the Commanders QB saying the situation won't be a distraction.

stories.title: Sources: CB Arnold plans to sign with Seahawks
stories.summary: Terrion Arnold also had visited the Houston Texans, New Orleans Saints and New York Giants before choosing the Seahawks.

stories.title: Source: Ohtani likely wouldn't opt out if team sold
stories.summary: Shohei Ohtani likely would not exercise a "key man" clause that would allow him to opt out of his contract if Mark Walter sold the Dodgers, a source told ESPN.

stories.title: Year later, Jones has no regrets trading Parsons
stories.summary: Jerry Jones likened the Micah Parsons deal to the 1989 trade of running back Herschel Walker to the Vikings that helped build the Cowboys' dynasty of the 1990s.

stories.title: Cavalli takes no-hitter into 7th as Nats rout Cubs
stories.summary: Cade Cavalli took a no-hitter into the seventh inning, and the Nationals beat the Cubs 7-0 on Thursday to avoid a three-game sweep.
